nodes.description: StandardToken.transfer(address,uint256) transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to and updates balances.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) moves tokens using the caller allowance and updates balances and allowed.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address) constant returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256) sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _value.
StandardToken.allowance(address,address) constant returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
ERC20Token.approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes) sets allowance then performs an external call to _spender.
ERC20Token fallback function that throws on any plain ether transfer.
ERC20Token constructor that mints the initial supply to msg.sender and sets token metadata and owner.
Token.totalSupply() abstract constant function returning the total token supply.
mapping(address => uint256) balances holding token balances of each holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed holding spending allowances.
uint256 public totalSupply holding the total amount of tokens.
string public name of the token.
uint8 public decimals used for display scaling.
string public symbol of the token.
string public version constant initialized to 'v1.0'.
address owner set to the deployer in the constructor.
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller address used as balance/allowance key, mint target and call forwarder.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transfer allowing arithmetic underflow.
balances[_to] += _value; unchecked addition in transfer/transferFrom allowing arithmetic overflow.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom.
_spender.call(...) arbitrary external call in approveAndCall, state already written before the call enabling reentrancy.
Unchecked initial mint balances[msg.sender] = 100000000000 and totalSupply = 100000000000 in the constructor.
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transfer, recipient address.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transfer, amount to transfer.
Parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom, source address.
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transferFrom, recipient address.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transferFrom, amount to transfer.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve, allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.approve, allowance amount.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.balanceOf, queried account.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance, allowance owner.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance, allowance spender.
Parameter _spender of ERC20Token.approveAndCall, also the external call target.
Parameter _value of ERC20Token.approveAndCall, allowance and forwarded amount.
Parameter _extraData of ERC20Token.approveAndCall, arbitrary bytes forwarded to callee.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mapping key of the unchecked balance subtraction.
_value from transfer flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
_value from transfer flows into the unchecked balance addition.
_to is used as the mapping key of the unchecked balance addition.
_from is used as the first mapping key of the unchecked allowance decrement.
_value from transferFrom flows into the unchecked allowance decrement.
msg.sender is used as the second mapping key of the allowance decrement.
_spender is the target of the arbitrary external call.
_value is forwarded as an argument to the external call.
_extraData attacker controlled bytes are forwarded to the external call.
msg.sender is forwarded to the callee as the approval source.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balances mapping.
Unchecked addition mutates the balances mapping.
Unchecked decrement mutates the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
Constructor sets the initial balance of msg.sender.
Constructor initializes totalSupply.
Constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
msg.sender determines initial mint recipient and owner.
transfer executes the unchecked balance subtraction.
transfer executes the unchecked balance addition.

Parameter _to of transferFrom is only used as the recipient index of the balance addition.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is consumed by the unchecked allowance decrement.

Parameter _value of approve is only used inside the approve function body.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf is only used to read balances inside balanceOf.
Parameter _owner of allowance is only used inside the allowance function body.
